Project's jest config matches only <rootDir>/__tests__/lib/**/*.test.ts (every existing test in the project lives under beads_web/__tests__/, not beads_web/src/__tests__/). No code-level deviation — implementation file beads_web/src/lib/coherence-journal.ts matches manifest exactly. Reviewer concurred (P3 finding: cosmetic metadata correction).
surprises_or_findings: (1) No `EventSummary` type was previously exported from beads_web/src/lib/. The closest existing type is `PipelineEvent` from event-log.ts, used as the JSONL row shape for events.jsonl. AC #15 directs the builder to source from event-log.ts and only fall back to the inline shape `{timestamp, type, epicId?, data?}` when no path is available. Decision: aliased `export type EventSummary = PipelineEvent` (no redefinition; PipelineEvent is a superset of the AC's inline-shape fallback — it has the same `type`, `timestamp`, `epicId` fields plus optional `stage`, `correlationId`, `payload`). Note for wlsr.14/15/16 (EscalationContext consumers): `import type { EventSummary } from '@/lib/coherence-journal'` resolves to PipelineEvent. The `payload` field name is NOT renamed to `data` — wlsr.14/15/16 should expect `event.payload` when carrying rule-specific event data forward. (2) Bead manifest test path has a spurious `src/` prefix that breaks jest discovery; non-blocking once corrected via placement. Recommended bd-update: drop the `src/` prefix from the test path in factory-core-wlsr.2's Files section if downstream tooling reads the manifest. (3) Reviewer P2 finding (advisory): the `as JournalEntry` cast in append() at the spread-into-fullEntry site bypasses compile-time check for new required fields added to JournalEntry in the future. Acceptable for v2 (no current required fields are at risk); flag if future edits add required fields.
recommendation_for_next: Wave 1 sibling beads can proceed in parallel (no inter-bead conflict — wlsr.2 lives in coherence-journal.ts which no other Wave 1 bead modifies). Phase B consumers (wlsr.14/15/16): import EscalationContext, AnomalyType, EventSummary from '@/lib/coherence-journal'; construct EscalationContext as plain TS objects in rule act() methods; pass to coherence dispatch path. Outcome classifier (wlsr.6): use new CoherenceJournal(repoPath).updateOutcome(entryId, 'positive'|'negative', rationale) — never mutate the file directly. Coherence agent prompt update (wlsr.8): document the journal R/W contract — read at start (j.all() or j.findSimilar(fp) or j.findByEpicId(epicId)); write at exit (j.append(entry)); EscalationReason MUST be set when decision.action === 'escalate'.
